install.title: Add Jedro+ to your Home Screen
install.subtitle: It opens like a real app and tells you about new bookings and calls right away.

ios.step1Hint: On iOS 26, Share is under the ⋯ button
ios.step2: Scroll down and choose Add to Home Screen
ios.step4: Open Jedro+ from your Home Screen and turn on notifications
ios.arrowHint: The Share button is down here

iosOther.title: Open this page in Safari
iosOther.body: On iPhone and iPad, Jedro+ is added to the Home Screen through Safari. Copy the link, open Safari and paste it into the address bar.

inApp.title: Open in your browser
inApp.body: This page is open inside another app. Tap ⋯ or ⋮, choose Open in browser, then follow the steps.

install.iosTooOld: Notifications on iPhone need iOS 16.4 or later. Update it in Settings → General → Software Update.

android.step1: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right
android.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen
android.samsungStep1: Tap the ≡ menu in the bottom right

desktop.step1: Click the Install icon on the right of the address bar
desktop.step2: Or open the ⋮ menu and choose Install Jedro+
desktop.safariStep1: In the menu bar, choose File → Add to Dock
desktop.firefox: Firefox doesn't install web apps, but notifications work right here in the browser.

install.installedBody: You'll find it on your Home Screen. Turn on notifications too so you never miss a booking.
install.alreadyInstalled: Jedro+ is already installed on this device.

push.title: Turn on notifications
push.subtitle: Know right away about new bookings, cancellations and calls waiting for a callback.
push.enabledBody: All Jedro+ notifications will come to this device.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Click the lock next to the address, allow notifications and try again.
push.deniedIos: Notifications are off. Turn them on in Settings → Notifications → Jedro+.
push.dismissed: Notifications are not on. You can turn them on any time in settings.
push.error: Couldn't turn on notifications. Please try again.
push.notConfigured: Device notifications aren't set up on the server yet.
push.unsupported: This browser doesn't support notifications. Use Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
push.needsInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications only work once Jedro+ is added to the Home Screen.
push.testBody: This is how new bookings, cancellations and calls will appear.

settings.note: Every new notification in the app also arrives as a notification on the device.
settings.testSent: Test notification sent. It should appear within a few seconds.
settings.testNotSubscribed: This device is no longer registered. Turn notifications off and on again.
settings.installNote: Steps for iPhone, Android and computer.
settings.installedNote: Jedro+ is installed on this device.
